exp_level_modifier.note: monster level minus player level -> % base exp (Renewal, irowiki Experience)

party_rules.note: rAthena even share only if every online member is within party_share_level (15) base levels; only members on the same map get a share. With 'each take' the killer (highest damage) gets the exp.

Pupa (never fight back) and Porings just west of Geffen: free exp
Chonchon swarm north of Geffen; quick kills, they hit a little
Willow outside Payon: slow earth plants, fire bolts one-shot them
Lunatic meadow north-west of Prontera, quiet
Hornet/Thief Bug west of Prontera: fast insects, keep red potions
Mandragora don't move: free kills for archers/mages, deadly for melee
Savage Babe/Hornet/Willow at the foot of Mt. Mjolnir, all passive
Rocker/Savage Babe, passive; Vocal (mini boss) spawns rarely
Roda Frog/Ambernite, water monsters: lightning bolts; only the rare Toad aggroes
Spore (water plant) field next to Payon, passive
Boa (earth snake) field near Payon, passive
Ambernite snails: high DEF, water; better for magic/archers
Payon Cave 1: slow aggro Zombies, Skeletons, Familiars; Holy Light / fire works, acolytes love it
Stainer/Creamy/Poporing east of Prontera, wind insects
Muka cactus + Peco Peco (fire, assist each other) south of Prontera
Peco Peco field: they assist, cold bolts / water against them
Mjolnir Coal Mine 1: Tarou/Familiar (dark) and Martin
Poporing/Marin: poison/water jellies, any element works
Poison Spore (aggro, poison) / Smokie; AoE recommended
Horn/Coco near Payon; the few Elder Willows aggro (cold bolts)
Coco squirrels, passive, south of Geffen
Elder Willow grove (aggro fire plants): cold bolts / water
Elder Willow/Yoyo on Mt. Mjolnir, mostly aggro
Yoyo monkeys (aggro, steal loot) and Horns
Payon Cave 2: Soldier/Archer Skeletons (aggro undead); party with a priest
Orc Village: Orc Warriors/Ladies all aggro and assist; AoE or a party; beware Orc Lord
Orc Lady field next to the village, all aggro
Wolf packs (assist), a few aggro Argos/Steel Chonchons
Goblin camp: five Goblin types, each a different element, all aggro
Geffen Dungeon 1: Hunter Flies (fast, aggro, drain HP) - bring a party
Coal Mine 3: aggro Skeleton Workers and Mysts
Argos (aggro poison spiders) / Beetle King / Flora
Orc Dungeon 1: mobs of Orc Zombies - priests Magnus/Turn Undead, wizards fire AoE
Payon Cave 3: Munak/Bongun/Soldier Skeletons, all undead
Magnolia (passive water demons) + some aggro Metallers
Payon Cave 4: Sohee (passive water demons), a few Whispers
Goblin Archers/Steamriders and Rotar Zairo, aggro
Geffen Dungeon 2: Ghoul/Jakk/Nightmare, all aggro - party
Dustiness (passive wind insects) + aggro Hunter Fly/Mantis; on the way to Al De Baran
Geographer (passive earth plants) / Dustiness near Juno
Petite (Sky, wind dragons) bunch in the corners: AoE
Clock Tower 1F (Al De Baran): Rideword/Punk aggro
Glast Heim Chivalry/Church: Evil Druid/Wraith undead - priest party
Harpy (silence!) / Goat; green potions if INT is low
Glast Heim Churchyard: Dark Priest/Wraith - Holy/Fire, priest party
Roween (wind wolves) near Rachel: earth weapons
Clock Tower B2: High Orc/Orc Archer, aggro
Glast Heim Underprison: Skel Prisoner/Injustice - iRO guide 80-111
Kobolds (3 elements), aggro; reduction cards help
Nogg Road 2: extremely mobby (Nightmare Terror/Deleter) - AoE party, fire armor
Magmaring (passive looters bunch on drops) - AoE them
Glast Heim Knight Hall 1: Raydric (dark) - party
Juperos 1: Venatu, extremely mobby, 2-cell attack range
Byalan 1 (iRO: 31-72 across floors); entry by Izlude boat NPC
Ant Hell 1: Ant Eggs never fight back, Familiars aggro
Sunken Ship 1: Hydra/Pirate Skeleton, mobby (Alberta sailor NPC)
Hode/Sandman/Frilldora, Phreeoni MVP (Renewal desert, no road)

knight.stats: STR 80-90 / AGI 60-80 / VIT 30-50 / DEX 30-40 (AGI+STR first; VIT once you tank)
knight.skills: Bash 10 > Two-Hand Sword Mastery 5 > Magnum Break 3 > Provoke 1 > Endure 1 (Riding) > Two-Hand Quicken 10 > Counter Attack 5 > Bowling Bash 10 > Riding/Cavalry Mastery
tricks: Bowling Bash knocks a target into others and hits every monster in its path: pull 3-5 mobs onto one cell, then BB
Two-Hand Quicken (+ASPD) before every pull
Magnum Break gives fire damage vs earth mobs and peels mobs off priests
Peco riding restores walk speed lost to weight
knight.gear: Katana -> Slayer -> Bastard Sword -> Two-Handed Sword (all NPC); Padded/Chain Mail; Muffler, Boots

crusader.stats: VIT 80 / STR 60-80 / DEX 40 / INT 20-40 (Holy Cross scales with INT a little)
crusader.skills: Sword Mastery 10, Bash 10, Faith 7 > Holy Cross 10 > Faith 10 > Auto Guard 5-10 > Shield Charge 3 > Shield Boomerang 3-5 > Reflect Shield 5 > Grand Cross 4 > Devotion
tricks: Holy Cross (holy) wrecks undead and dark dungeons (Payon Cave, Orc Dungeon, Glast Heim)
Auto Guard + shield: best party tank before Paladin
Shield Boomerang is a ranged pull
Faith (Trust) 10 unlocks Heal for undead spots
crusader.gear: Sword/Saber -> Tsurugi/Haedonggum; Buckler -> Shield; Chain Mail -> Full Plate

wizard.stats: INT 90-99 / DEX 60-80 / VIT 30-60 (VIT before 60 keeps you alive); Renewal: variable cast hits 0 at DEX*2+INT = 530
wizard.skills: Fire/Cold/Lightning Bolt 5-10 > Napalm Beat 1 > Frost Diver 1 > Stone Curse 1 > Fire Ball 5 > Sight 1 > Fire Wall 5 > Thunder Storm 1 > Jupitel 3-10 > Storm Gust 10 > Earth Spike 3 > Heaven's Drive > Sightrasher 2 > Meteor Storm / Lord of Vermilion
tricks: Bolt matching element: cold vs fire, lightning vs water, fire vs earth/undead, Earth Spike vs wind
Storm Gust behind a tank: freeze and wipe a whole pull (Orc Dungeon, Glast Heim)
Fire Wall between you and melee mobs when solo
Safety Wall when a melee mob reaches you; Frost Diver to freeze dangerous ones
sit to regen SP after each pull (Increase SP Recovery)
wizard.gear: Rod -> Wand -> Staff (NPC); Silk Robe; Hat/Biretta; Muffler; Sandals

sage.stats: INT 90 / DEX 60-80 / VIT 30-50 / AGI 20 (battle sage: STR/AGI melee + autospell)
sage.skills: Bolts 10 > Napalm 4 > Soul Strike > Advanced Book 5 > Cast Cancel 1 > Free Cast 4 > Auto Spell 10 > Stone Curse 1 > Endow skills > Earth Spike/Heaven's Drive > Dispell
tricks: Endow party weapons (Flame Launcher vs earth, Frost Weapon vs fire)
Free Cast lets you walk while casting: kite melee
Earth Spike (needs Seismic Weapon 1 via Stone Curse) vs wind monsters
Land Protector against MVP AoE
sage.gear: Book (Bible/Tablet) or Rod; Silk Robe; Muffler
spots: same as wizard, single target: gef_fild01, prt_fild02, gef_fild05, mjolnir_12, yuno_fild04

hunter.stats: DEX 90-99 / AGI 50-80 / LUK 30-40 (Blitz) or INT 30-50 + VIT (trapper)
hunter.skills: Owl's Eye 3 > Vulture's Eye 10 > Improve Concentration > Double Strafe 10 > Arrow Shower 5 > Beast Bane 1 > Falconry Mastery > Blitz Beat 5 > Steel Crow > Skid Trap 1 > Ankle Snare > Land Mine > Claymore
tricks: Element arrows: fire arrows vs earth, crystal vs fire, wind vs water
auto Blitz Beat procs from LUK (~LUK/3 %) cost no SP - cheap levelling
Ankle Snare a melee mob then shoot
Claymore Trap (fire 5x5) on mob piles; Land Mine stuns
always keep 2+ cells distance, kite with the movement after each Double Strafe
hunter.gear: Bow -> Composite Bow -> Great Bow / Crossbow -> Arbalest (NPC); arrows by element; Adventurer Suit -> Coat

bard.skills: Owl 3 > Vulture 10 > Double Strafe 10 > Arrow Shower 5 > Music Lessons 3-10 > Musical Strike 5 > Adaptation > Encore > Dissonance 3 > Poem of Bragi / Assassin Cross of Sunset
tricks: levels like an archer (Double Strafe) until songs
Poem of Bragi (cast/delay cut) for party casters, A Whistle for flee
needs an instrument (Violin/Guitar) for songs; bows for DS
bard.gear: Bow route, then Violin/Guitar; light armor
spots: party with casters in Orc Dungeon/Glast Heim

dancer.skills: Owl 3 > Vulture 10 > Double Strafe 10 > Arrow Shower 5 > Dance Lessons 3-10 > Throw Arrow (Slinging Arrow) 5 > Adaptation > Encore > Hip Shaker 3 > Service For You / Fortune's Kiss
tricks: levels like an archer until dances
Service For You (SP cost down, MaxSP up) for casters, Fortune's Kiss for crits
dancer.gear: Bow route, then Whip; light armor

priest.stats: full support: INT 90-99 / VIT 60-90 / DEX 20-40; exorcist: INT 90 / DEX 60-80 / VIT 60
priest.skills: Heal 3 > Increase AGI 1 > Divine Protection 5 > Blessing 5-10 > Increase AGI 10 > Heal 10 > Ruwach > Teleport 1-2 > Warp Portal 4 > Pneuma > Angelus 2 > Holy Water > Cure | Kyrie 10 > Magnificat 3-5 > Gloria > Impositio 3 > Aspersio > Suffragium 3 > Sanctuary 7 > Lex Divina 5 > Lex Aeterna > Resurrection 1 > Turn Undead 3 > Safety Wall 1 (Aspersio 4 + Sanctuary 3) > Magnus Exorcismus 10
tricks: buff order: Blessing + Increase AGI on everyone, Kyrie on the tank, Magnificat when the party sits, Impositio on hitters
heal at ~65% for the tank, earlier for squishies; Sanctuary under the tank when several mobs hit
Heal damages undead (holy): Payon Cave / Orc Dungeon solo
Turn Undead + Magnus Exorcismus in Orc Dungeon, Glast Heim Churchyard (blue gemstones)
Pneuma vs archers (Archer Skeleton, Gargoyle, Orc Archer)
Warp Portal saves the party walks; memo dungeon entrances
priest.gear: Rod/Mace; Silk Robe; Buckler; Muffler; Sandals

monk.stats: combo: STR 80-90 / AGI 80-90 / VIT 30 / DEX 40; Asura: STR/INT/DEX/VIT
monk.skills: Heal 3, Increase AGI, Divine Protection 10, Demon Bane 10 (Iron Fists prereq) > Iron Fists 10 > Summon Spirit Sphere 5 > Flee 5 > Triple Attack 10 > Chain Combo 5 > Combo Finish 5 > Absorb Spirits 1 > Fury 3 > Investigate 3 > Finger Offensive 3 > Asura Strike 5 > Steel Body
tricks: Triple Attack procs ~30% of hits, Chain Combo -> Combo Finish follows with SP
Investigate ignores DEF: great vs high-DEF Ambernite/Holden/Pitman
Asura Strike (Fury + 5 spheres, all SP) one-shots tough targets: rest/Magnificat between casts
Demon Bane + Heal let monks solo undead caves
monk.gear: Waghnak -> Knuckle Duster -> Claw/Finger (NPC); Wooden Mail; Muffler

blacksmith.stats: STR 80-90 / DEX 40-60 / AGI 50-70 / VIT 40 / LUK some
blacksmith.skills: Enlarge Weight 5 > Pushcart 3-10 > Mammonite 10 > Discount > Vending 3 > Hammer Fall 2 > Adrenaline Rush 5 > Hilt Binding 1 > Weapon Research 2-10 > Weapon Perfection 3 > Power Thrust (Over Thrust) 5 > Maximize Power
tricks: Adrenaline Rush (+ASPD for axes/maces, party too) and Power Thrust (+ATK) up at all times
Mammonite costs zeny per hit: fine at 10x, keep 5k reserve
Hammer Fall stuns a group around the target
Weapon Perfection ignores size penalty
vend loot from the cart; Discount/Overcharge pay off
blacksmith.gear: Axe -> Battle Axe -> Hammer -> Buster/Two-Handed Axe (NPC)

alchemist.skills: Enlarge Weight 5 > Pushcart > Mammonite 10 > Axe Mastery 10 > Potion Research 5 > Prepare Potion 5 > Acid Terror 5 / Bomb (Demonstration) 5 > Aid Potion (Potion Pitcher) > Bioethics > Call Homunculus
tricks: Acid Terror (Acid Bottle) ignores DEF: tough single targets
Bomb (Demonstration, fire ground) on mob piles, breaks weapons
brew potions (Red/Yellow/White) to sell
Homunculus (Lif heals, Vanilmirth damage) once you can
spots: Fire Bomb on earth mobs: pay_fild07, mjolnir_07

assassin.stats: crit katar: AGI 80-90 / STR 60-80 / LUK 30-40 / DEX 30-40 / VIT 30; Sonic Blow: STR 90 / AGI 70 / DEX 50
assassin.skills: Double Attack 10 > Improve Dodge 10 > Steal 5 > Hiding 2 > Envenom 1 | Katar Mastery 4-10 > Sonic Blow 10 > Cloaking 2-3 > Grimtooth 5 > Righthand Mastery > Lefthand Mastery > Enchant Poison 3-5 > Poison React
tricks: katars double your crit rate (LUK/3 * 2)
Sonic Blow 8 hits (2 s delay) burst; best with STR
Grimtooth from Cloaking hits mobs 3x3 at range: mobbing
Enchant Poison vs non-poison mobs; dodge tanks for parties at high AGI
Double Attack (thief) applies with daggers/dual daggers before katars
assassin.gear: Dagger/Main Gauche -> Jur -> Katar (Katar line NPC: Jur, Katar, Jamadhar)

rogue.stats: AGI 80 / STR 60-80 / DEX 40-60 (bow rogue: DEX 90, Double Strafe)
rogue.skills: Double Attack 10 > Improve Dodge > Steal 10 > Hiding 1 > Envenom | Snatcher 4 > Steal Coin 4 > Back Stab 4-10 > Tunnel Drive 2 > Raid 5 > Intimidate 5 > Vulture's Eye 10 > Double Strafe 5-10 > Plagiarism
tricks: Snatcher auto-steals while hitting: free loot
Raid from Hiding stuns/blinds everything around (Tunnel Drive 2 required)
bow rogues copy archers: Double Strafe with Vulture's Eye
Strip skills vs bosses later
Plagiarism copies a skill used on you (e.g. Bowling Bash, Storm Gust) - party with a Wizard
rogue.gear: Dagger -> Gladius -> Damascus; Bow route for DS rogues; Thief Clothes
